title: Book Three · Chapter 131: Leo's Useful Idea
story:
On the third Friday, Ronan brings home another six yuan.

Three full weeks: eighteen earned. He has spent one yuan on peanuts. Seventeen stays in the work envelope.

Leo's nineteenth reply is on the table. Ten days have passed since Ronan posted his letter.

Ronan washes his hands before he opens it.

Leo writes about a long walk with a friend. They talked past their bus stop and had to walk back through the heat.

The driver needed your old voice, he writes.

Ronan smiles. The old voice is in his own letter, after the story about the tape.

Then Leo asks about the workshop counter.

Do people bring clear sizes? Perhaps you could write the usual questions on one sheet. Name, use, size. You would not need to start again each time.

Ronan reads the idea twice. He finds a clean page and tries the three headings.

Mum comes in with a finished sleeve. She looks at his page while she lays the work down.

“New customer?”

“Questions for the workshop. Leo's idea.”

She reads the headings.

“What will it be used for?” she asks.

“That is this one.”

Ronan points to use. Then he puts the longer question beneath it.

Mum looks at the last heading.

“Some people will not have the size.”

“I can leave a space. Mr Sun can say what we need next.”

She nods and takes out her own customer book. He can see a clear space below one name.

“I am waiting for the woman to bring her coat,” she says. “I can't get a sleeve size from her bag.”

Ronan laughs. Mum puts the book away and checks the finished sleeve near the light.

He writes a short question under each heading. Then he reads them aloud, one at a time.

Mum listens to the first two.

“Less old man,” she says.

“A little old man?”

“Your own voice will do.”

He smiles and starts again.

Afterward, he folds the sheet into his work notebook for Monday. Leo's letter goes beside the birthday book on his shelf.

Outside, Dad is back from work and talking with Mr Qiu. Ronan takes his football into the yard.

Dad turns at the sound of the ball. He gives Ronan a light pass with his shoe, then returns to Mr Qiu's story.

Ronan catches the ball between his feet. He leaves it there while the two men laugh, then sends it gently against the clear wall.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

heading＝栏目标题；usual＝通常的、常见的；use＝用途；aloud＝出声地。

## 理解问题

1. Leo的第十九封回复隔多久到达？他提出了什么确实有用的办法？
2. 不知道尺寸时，Ronan准备怎样处理？这时工资累计和余额各是多少？

## 读句子

**Then he puts the longer question beneath it.**

拆开看：Then / he puts / the longer question / beneath it.

随后／他写下／更完整的那个问题／在标题下方。
